    Generate Rolling SSM Parameters for Forecasting

    get_ssm_forecast_parameters.Rd

    Estimates model parameters over an expanding window up to a specified end date. Returns a list of parameters to be used in a separate forecasting step.

    get_ssm_forecast_parameters(
  data,
  y_cols,
  x_col,
  date_col = "quarter",
  all_builder_functions,
  spec,
  all_defaults,
  forecast_start,
  val_T1 = "2015-01-01",
  forecast_end = NULL
)

    Arguments

    data

    The Dataframe that contains full data$

    y_cols

    The Name of the Y column(s) in the data dataframe

    x_col

    The column that contains the data for exogenous variales

    date_col

    the column name of the date column

    spec

    the okun model specification

    all_defaults

    the default guesses

    forecast_start

    The date where the forecast stats, limit of the available information set

    val_T1

    the beginning of the forecast information set

    Details

    We have T = 1 as the start of the data, T=T is the end of the data, T=t as the current date up until we have the data availabe for the pseudo forecast and t+h would then be the forecast horizon. What we do here is just get the parameter estimation at time t
